description: Ruffle 0.2.0 (Flash/SWF emulator) at C:\Program Files\ruffle\bin, exposed on the machine PATH
verify: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p='C:\\Program Files\\ruffle\\bin'; if(((Get-Item (Join-Path $p 'ruffle.exe')).VersionInfo.ProductVersion -like '0.2.0*') -and (([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') -split ';') -contains $p)){$true}else{throw 'missing executable or PATH entry'}"
